topic: the quiet power of saying no
lines: Yes to favours you don't have time *for.*
Yes to people who never say yes to *you.*
Yes to the extra shift nobody else *wanted.*
Yes because no felt too *hard* to say.
Why there's never time for your own *goals.*
#Every yes to something is a no to something *else.*
Clear about what matters. Clear about where your *energy* goes.
You don't need a long explanation. You don't need to *apologise.*
No, thank you, is a complete *sentence.*
#The first few times, it will feel *uncomfortable.*
That's usually the sign it was *needed.*
Because one day, you'll wish you *had.*
end: Save this for the next time you want to say no.

post.title: The Quiet Power of Saying No
post.caption: Every yes to something is a no to yourself. 🛑
post.first_comment: What's something you need to say no to this week? 👇
